query: Do I have to inform ICA if there is a change in passport number due to passport renewal?
reference_answer: The updating of new passport number is not required after the submission of the Pre-Marriage LTVP Assessment (PMLA). However, please take note to update your new passport number in the online application form during your Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) application.

The validity of the ABTC is five years or up to the validity of the passport, whichever is shorter. However, if your Singapore passport number has changed, you need to apply for a new ABTC under the category of 'replacement due to change of particulars'. You should submit an application only after you have collected your new passport.
answer: No, you don't have to inform Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA) if there's a change in passport number due to renewal. This is because for Singapore Passport Holders, you do not need to update your new passport information separately every time you renew your passport. [Document 2]
